title: GuardianCore
body:
# 📖 What’s GuardianCore?
Say goodbye to limitations — GuardianCore is the next-generation replacement for EssentialsX, designed to give you total control over your server’s commands, customization, and player management.

Packed with all the essential commands you know and love, GuardianCore goes further with a full suite of advanced features — from powerful GUI-based editors to deep tracking tools, customizable kits, dynamic menus, and a fully configurable experience.

No extra plugins. No limitations. Just full power, right out of the box.

# ✅ Key Features
- Complete EssentialsX alternative — includes all standard commands with even more flexibility.
- Create unlimited custom commands in config.yml, with placeholders and conditions.
- Design fully interactive menus and GUIs in menus.yml — clickable items, lore, actions, and more.
- Full customization — every message can be edited via the messages folder (multi-language support included).
- GUI-powered item editors — rename items, edit lore (with color codes & multi-line support), enchant, and more.
- Kit system with full GUI control — set permissions, cooldowns, commands, and descriptions.
- Track player history — view last login/logout locations, teleport history, and actions.
- Rollback system — inspect and revert player actions like block breaking/placing.
- Built-in backup manager — create, list, and restore plugin data backups.
- Advanced teleportation system — includes TPA requests, TP history, and logs.
- All actions are logged — inventory views, teleportation, item changes, and more.
- Each player gets an individual data file, laying the groundwork for even deeper personalization in future versions.
